correctness.rationale: The all-length proof uses the unique zero-run parameterization x=0^g0 1 ... 1 0^gw, the invariant five nonzero-grade counts under g_i>=2 extension, and an exact stars-and-bars lift E_{n,w}(h). The disjoint capped-vector partition makes F_{n,w}(s)=sum_{Phi(h)=s} E_{n,w}(h) exhaustive, including t=0; its sum is binomial(n,w). All h containing a 2 are feasible for n>=3w+2, while the all-2 signature has 3w one-positive length-three windows and cannot occur at n=3w+1. Direct enumeration of the 65 positive capped four-gap tuples gives 29 distinct signatures, and enumeration for n=3,...,10 gives 1,2,6,9,16,21,26,28. Independent direct-versus-cap arithmetic checks were performed for bounded n,w; these finite checks are not the universal proof.
residual_risks: No noisy, incomplete, cyclic, or rotation-identified reads; general weights have a finite signature formula not a closed polynomial.
